blocks.text: Replication ke baad DNA ke taqreeban har 146 nucleotides (DNA 2 nm mota) aik histone octamer ke gird do chakkar lipat-te hain. Histone octamer 8 histone molecules ka set hai: H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies. Is tarah nucleosomes bante hain. Nucleosomes aapas mein taqreeban 80 nucleotides lambe linker DNA se jure hote hain. Paanchwin qisam ka histone, H1, jise linker histone kehte hain, nucleosome ki bunyad par us jagah hota hai jahan DNA andar aata aur bahar nikalta hai; yeh nucleosomes ki zanjeer ko lapetne mein madad deta hai. Saare nucleosomes (linker histone ke baghair) dhaage mein piroye motiyon (beads on a string) jaise lagte hain; ise nucleosome string (11 nm moti) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: histone octamer, do tehon wali disc jis ki oopri satah chaar rangeen histones H2B, H3, H4 aur H2A mein banti hai. Saath taqreeban 146 nucleotides ka lehrata DNA. Hara teer nucleosome string ki taraf: DNA teen octamers ke gird lipta hai, jaise dhage par moti, aur nucleosome ki bunyad par histone H1.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.3: Nucleosome string (kitab ki Figure 19.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: H2B, H3, H4, H2A, Histone octamer, DNA (about 146 nucleotides), Nucleosome, H1, Nucleosome string.

blocks.alt: Kitab ki tarah aik musalsal khaaka: oopar DNA double helix jo daen taraf chaura hota hai (2 nm); DNA surkh histone octamers ke gird lipat kar nucleosomes ki zigzag qataar banata hai, beech mein linker DNA aur peele linker histones (11 nm); chromatin fibre wapas baen taraf (30 nm); daano wala supercoil phir daen taraf (300 nm); condensed chromatin baen taraf lipat-ta hai (700 nm); aur neeche daen do sister chromatids wala chromosome, 1,400 nm ka teer dono par.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: Chromosome ki tanzeem (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: DNA, 2 nm, Histone octamer, Nucleosome, Linker DNA, Linker histone, 11 nm, Chromatin fibre, 30 nm, Supercoil, 300 nm, Condensed chromatin, 700 nm, Chromatid, 1,400 nm.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: DNA darja ba darja lipat-ta hai: DNA 2 nm, nucleosome string 11 nm, chromatin fibre 30 nm, supercoil 300 nm, chromatid 700 nm. Poore duplicate chromosome (do chromatids) ki chaurai 1,400 nm hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 19.4 mein aik chromatid par 1,400 nm likha hai, jab ke kitab ka apna text chromatid ko 700 nm mota batata hai. Sahi yeh hai ke aik chromatid 700 nm hai aur 1,400 nm dono chromatids, yaani poore chromosome, ki chaurai hai. Hamare diagram mein yahi durust dikhaya gaya hai.
